name: framewright-client
description: Framewright client — React app hosting the generated CMS sections and the Generator Studio. Scaffolded at T-001 (docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 1). Run `npm install` here, then `npm run dev` for http://localhost:5173. Nothing in ../tests/ requires these dependencies to be installed: the app-shell verification asserts the §5.2 reducer map and the route table statically, so `npm test` still runs on a fresh clone with no install.
